## Message

```
error X18N1003: Unknown preset: <detail>
  Use a preset name listed in the docs, or a preset object.
```

The CLI prints the code, the message and a detail, such as a file name or a field. The hint follows on the next line. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A string in `presets` is not the name of a built-in preset, and x18n has no plugin loader in this runtime.

1. Use a name from the [presets list](/presets).
2. Or pass a preset object from a TS config, for example `presets: [vueI18n()]`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `2`.
